executive_summary: The vendor proposal fails to meet critical requirements for AuroraCold Distribution AG. It proposes coverage for only 6 warehouses instead of 8, integrates with PostgreSQL instead of the mandatory Microsoft SQL Server, and violates the hard-gate no-migration constraint. Pricing and timelines are vague.
strengths: Proposes a phased onboarding and migration plan.
weaknesses_and_gaps: Covers only 6 warehouses instead of the required 8.
Integrates with PostgreSQL instead of Microsoft SQL Server.
Violates the hard gate against database migration.
Timeline lacks specific dates for the 10-week pilot and 7-month rollout.
Pricing is provided as a vague range rather than a firm fixed price.

check_results.evidence_quote: Real-time inventory dashboard across 6 regional warehouses.

rfp_evidence.quote: Provide a web-based dashboard displaying near-real-time inventory and temperature status for all eight distribution centres.

proposal_evidence.quote: Real-time inventory dashboard across 6 regional warehouses.

suggested_clarifications: Can the dashboard be extended to cover all eight distribution centres?
Does the dashboard include near-real-time temperature status?
scorecard.evaluation_notes: Proposal covers only 6 warehouses instead of 8 and omits temperature monitoring.

rfp_evidence.quote: Generate alerts when a threshold is exceeded and notify the responsible site manager by email and in-app notification.

suggested_clarifications: Does the system support temperature excursion alerts?
